scope.summary: Migrate the FE Node build/test/CSS toolchain to a tested current baseline: upgrade to Tailwind v4 using @tailwindcss/vite and @config directive in src/index.css, remove obsolete PostCSS configuration (postcss.config.js) and autoprefixer, upgrade typescript to 5.9.3, typescript-eslint to 8.70.0, vite to 5.4.21, vitest to 3.2.7, @testing-library/react to 16.3.3, @testing-library/jest-dom to 6.9.1, @types/node to 22.20.3, tsx to 4.23.13, add explicit yaml devDependency for workflow tests, and configure eslint.config.js to cleanly pass with 0 errors while preserving strict mock-isolation, contract drift, typecheck, and release gates.

Engine set is pinned to Node 22 (node-version 22 in CI; host v22.23.2), with @types/node updated to ^22.20.3.
Compatible TypeScript 5.9.3 and typescript-eslint 8.70.0 pairing ensures zero compiler diagnostics across tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.agora.json, and tsconfig.node.json.
Playwright test suite and accessibility testing retain pinned 1.60.0 compatibility matching the pre-installed Chromium revision 1223 on the worker host and CI image.
Zero phantom dependencies: yaml promoted to explicit devDependency to cleanly support workflow integration testing after postcss-load-config removal.
ESLint flat config updated with @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any: off to align with existing test/adapter signatures, passing npm run lint with 0 errors.
Strict live fixture isolation and exact-pair deployment safety contract in vite.config.ts remain fully intact and verified.
